question: What complete understanding of the eightfold-of-eight division is being sought?
premises: Full knowledge of this division is desired.
The knowing is sought in an exhaustive manner.
inference: The speaker seeks exhaustive understanding of the division into eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of anantathā as endlessly or exhaustively is context-dependent.
plain_english: I wish to know fully and exhaustively the division into eight groups of eight.
